# Noqeri UI 0.1.0

Initial experimental release with 102 Noqeri-authored component APIs, responsive CSS, token-based themes, accessible native forms/disclosure, sample app, documentation, and CI using the current experimental Noqeri web-view compiler.

## Compatibility

- Noqeri browser-view build path in EMN90909/Noqeri main, Node.js 22+ for build.
- Copy `src/components.noqeri` into app `noqeri/components.noqeri` and `styles.css` into the app root before compilation.
- Does not support automatic npm-like package resolution or the Node-free static native web compiler.
- Explicitly not stable or production-qualified for complex overlays or screen-reader audited widgets.

## Changes

New package; no previous releases to migrate.
